tags.name: Localization and Language
tags.description:
### Language support in the API

The API supports localized data for certain fields. The response language can be specified using the `Accept-Language` header. The header value must match one of the languages provided by the `/utils/languages` endpoint.

If the `Accept-Language` header is missing or the specified language is not supported, responses default to English (`en`). For fields without a translation in the requested language, the API returns the value in English. Endpoints that do not return translated data ignore this header.

refresh_token.description: Token for obtaining a new access token.

get.description:
Action returns basic information about products currently available in our offer. Parameters like description, category name, and unit are translated according to the Accept-Language header set in request (see more here [Localization and Language](#tag/Localization-and-Language)). This endpoint is limited by the maximum number of symbols that can be submitted as input to this action. The maximum number of symbols is equal to 50.

Products symbols not found in product catalog will be omitted in response. If the request contains only one invalid product symbol, an empty array will be returned.

**Note:** Provide either `symbols` or `mpns`.

get.description: This action returns a list of product prices, stock levels, and delivery details for the TME warehouse. This method is limited by the maximum number of symbols that can be submitted as input to this action. The maximum number of symbols is equal to 50.

parameters.name: currency
parameters.description: Currency identifier, according to which price values will be returned.

parameters.name: scope[]
parameters.description:
Type of data to be returned. At least one value is required.
- If `scope[]` includes `prices` or `stock`, only `symbols[]` is required.
- If `scope[]` includes `delivery` or `delivery_confirmed`, both `symbols[]` and `amounts[]` are required.
 - `delivery` and `delivery_confirmed` cannot be used together.

parameters.name: amounts[]
parameters.description:
A list of product quantities used to calculate delivery availability and confirmed delivery dates. This parameter is mandatory when requesting data within the `delivery` or `delivery_confirmed` scope. Delivery information will be returned for each quantity specified in the request.

List of amounts for products given in the `symbols[]` parameter. The order of elements in `amounts[]` must match the order of elements in `symbols[]`.

200.description: Successful response containing status and data.

status.description: Response status. "OK" indicates that the action was successful.

stock_quantity.description: Number of products in stock. Returns null if only `prices` query parameter is selected.

short_name.description: Short name of unit type e.g. 'pcs'.

prices.description: Product pricing details. Returns null if `prices` query parameter is not selected.

amount.description: Minimum quantity required for the price tier.

price.description: Unit price for the quantity tier.

special.description: Indicates if the price is a special customer price.

deliveries.description: List of product stock and delivery status details. Returns null if `delivery` or `delivery_confirmed` query parameter is not selected.

status.description:
Information about availability:
- **DS_AVAILABLE_IN_STOCK** - Product available in stock.
- **DS_DATE_AS_WEEK** - Product ordered from supplier with confirmed delivery.
- **DS_SUPPLIER_WAREHOUSE_DATE_AS_WEEK** - Product available from supplier. Minimum purchase quantities may apply. Estimated warehouse delivery is provided (for an order placed today).
- **DS_WAITING_FOR_CONFIRMATION_FROM_VENDOR** - Product ordered from supplier, awaiting confirmation.
- **DS_DELIVERY_NEEDS_CONFIRMATION** - Product not yet ordered from supplier. Please contact our sales department.

For **DS_DATE_AS_WEEK** and **DS_SUPPLIER_WAREHOUSE_DATE_AS_WEEK** statuses, `data` returns `week`, `year`, `range_start`, `range_end` and `supply_date`.

For **DS_DELIVERY_NEEDS_CONFIRMATION** status, `data` returns `waiting_period` and `supply_date`.

For all other statuses, `data` is null.

amount.description: Number of items available for the status.

data.description: Estimated delivery date details based on the status.

waiting_period.description: Standard manufacturer lead time in weeks.

get.description:
This action returns a list of additional photos and documents correlated with specified products. The method is limited by the maximum number of product symbols that can be submitted as an input to this action. The maximum number of symbols is equal to 50.

 Endpoint can return these types of documents:

- **INS** - Manual,
- **DTE** - Documentation,
- **KCH** - Safety Data Sheet,
- **GWA** - Warranty,
- **INB** - Safety instructions,
- **MOV** - Video,
- **YTB** - YouTube video,
- **PRE** - Presentation,
- **SFT** - Software.

200.description: Successful response containing status and data.

status.description: Response status. "OK" indicates that the action was successful.

additional.description: List of additional images with different resolutions.

presentation.description: List of images used for 360° product presentation.

This action is used to search the product database based on specified criteria (e.g. search phrase, category, or product attributes (parameters)).

**Note:** Provide either `phrase` or `category_id`, or both.

parameters.description: Type of data to be returned. At least one value is required.

parameters.description: Search phrase, which may contain multiple words.

parameters.name: parameters[]
parameters.description:
Filter parameters grouped by index. Each group must contain `parameters[n][id]` and one or more `parameters[n][values][]`. Multiple filter groups can be specified.

Example: `parameters[0][id]=2&parameters[0][values][]=156&parameters[0][values][]=179&parameters[1][id]=367&parameters[1][values][]=1443865`

values[].description: Identifiers of values for the given filtering parameter. At least one value is required when `parameters[n][id]` is provided.

200.description: Successful response containing status and data.
